title: verbena litoralis f. congesta
intro: Verbena litoralis f. congesta, commonly known as Chilean verbena or coastal verbena, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Verbenaceae. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of Verbena litoralis f. congesta include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and soothe digestive issues, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health concerns.
